issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted 2026-08-16) decided to add a `ready_frontier` check to `bead doctor` under the `dependencies` scope: warn when open issues carry an assignee (excluded from the ready frontier without an active claim — the state behind the measured 583-issue fleet starvation), name a bounded sample of offending ids, and state the exact remedy (`bead update <id> --clear-assignee`). No open bead tracks it; check for a closed implementation bead before starting. Advisory only: doctor never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`. Tests: assigned-open issues warn with ids and remedy; in_progress, closed, unassigned-blocked, and deliberately parked cases behave as specified; `--repair` leaves assignment untouched. Update doctor help and docs.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Implement the ADR-005 doctor ready_frontier check for assigned open issues

issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted, 2026-08-12) commits to a third dependency kind, `verifies`, so inverted verification gates can be diagnosed structurally instead of by title heuristics, and explicitly defers it as 'post-0.1 item R025' — no open bead in the queue covers it. Work: extend the dependency model and §3.4 validation to accept `verifies` edges; add the inversion diagnosis as report-only output (never reject at insert time, never infer from titles), surfaced through doctor/diagnostics and R023 `why` context; teach the field guide (`bead schema explain`) and the checkpoint import/export round trip the new kind; add audit events, cycle-interaction, round-trip, and concurrency tests per the 'every mutating operation atomic, auditable, concurrency-tested' rule.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
